title: Flight Test Telemetry Analysis System — Overview and definition
t: Flight Test Telemetry Analysis System — Overview and definition
description: Synchronizes and analyzes flight-test measurements into engineering results.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Synchronizes and analyzes flight-test measurements into engineering results. A flight-test telemetry system decommutates PCM streams, synchronizes video/1553/bus data, calibrates engineering units, and computes test-point results with uncertainty. Real implementations include IADS, vendor ground stations, and Python post-processing. It supports real-time quick-look and post-flight deep analysis. Flight-test engineering use only.
